purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom spell-school profiles that require native school/access verification. This is static row/profile verification only; it does not prove spellbook access mutation, cast-gate behavior, prepared spell state, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredStaticEvidence: paired spell-low and spell-high rows for each effect key
requiredRuntimeProof: caster law-owner correlation proof when runtime add-ons are used

forbiddenSubstitutes: ranged support without gunpowder or Focus predicate
cove.space-arcane-gunpowder-support.notes: Cove native school verification must match exact Space/Arcane profile rows; Focus, gunpowder, and cast events remain companion runtime predicates.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any Primal school row as fire/gating proof
inferno.primal-fire-gating-charge.notes: Inferno native school verification must match exact Primal profile rows; fire/gating/sacrifice semantics remain companion runtime predicates.

forbiddenSubstitutes: prepared state inferred from cooldown value
tower.prepared-spellbook-reuse.notes: Tower native school verification must read the generator profile school; prepared reuse state remains a separate runtime predicate.
